data.name: Jemaria
data.long_meaning: Jemaria is a Hebrew name derived from the roots 'yam' (sea) and 'iah' (God). It is traditionally interpreted as 'God is my help' or 'God has upheld'. This name is mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of a Levite who helped King Hezekiah during the Assyrian siege.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes trust and reliance on God during times of difficulty.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Jemaria is a 3 life path number name, which indicates creativity, self-expression, and communication. Those with this name are often natural artists, musicians, or writers, and have a strong desire to express their unique perspective on the world.

in_hebrew.name: ג'מריה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים יקים או מריה היא משרתו של אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ג'מריה הוא שם עברי שמורכב משתי מילים: 'ג'ם' שפירושו מריה או ים, ו'אלוהים' שפירושו אלוהים. השם ג'מריה ניתן לפרש כ'אלוהים יקים' או 'מריה היא משרתו של אלוהים'. הוא משויך לאישיות מקראית שמוזכרת בספר ירמיהו, פרק כו, פסוק 20, שם נזכר ג'מריהו בן חלפיה ככוהן שנתן תמיכה לנביא ירמיהו.

in_greek.name: Γεμαρία
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο υψηλοί ή Γεμαρία είναι υπηρέτης του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Γεμαρία είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος ג'מריה. Είναι πιθανόν να σχετίζεται με τη λέξη 'gemar', που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο υψηλοί' ή 'Γεμαρία είναι υπηρέτης του Θεού'. Στο πλαίσιο της Καινής Διαθήκης και της πρώιμης Εκκλησίας, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει τη σχέση του Θεού με τους πιστούς και την υπηρεσία τους προς Αυτόν.

in_latin.name: Gemaria
in_latin.meaning: Deus exaltat vel Gemaria est servus Dei
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gemaria derivatur ex hebraico ג'מריה, quod componitur ex 'gem' vel 'gemar', significans 'exaltat' vel 'Deus exaltat', et 'Deus' vel 'servus Dei'. In traditione christiana, nomen Gemaria potest significare 'Deus exaltat' vel 'Gemaria est servus Dei', exprimens relationem servilem et exaltationem divinam.

in_english.name: Jemaria
in_english.meaning: God exalts or Jemaria is a servant of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jemaria originates from the Hebrew name ג'מריה (Gemariah), which means 'God exalts' or 'Jemaria is a servant of God'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'gem' or 'gemar', meaning 'exaltation' or 'high', and 'Yah' or 'Deus', signifying God. The name Jemaria appears in the Bible in Jeremiah 26:20, where Gemariah, son of Hilkiah, is mentioned as a priest who supported the prophet Jeremiah. In Christian tradition, Jemaria symbolizes divine exaltation and servanthood to God, conveying spiritual humility and devotion.

biblical_reference.note: Gemariah, son of Hilkiah, a priest who supported Jeremiah

historical_references.reference: Jemariah is mentioned in the Old Testament as the head of a genealogical list of priests who returned from exile in Babylon to Jerusalem to rebuild the temple. (Ezra 2:2)
Jemariah is also mentioned in the New Testament as a prophet who prophesied concerning the virgin birth of Jesus Christ to King Herod in Bethlehem. (Matthew 2:16)
